findings.evidence: work.rs uses manually calibrated costs described as measurements under Node. Supplied regression tests use native deadlines of several seconds; no guest timing results substantiate the README's approximately 125 ms budget across desktop, Android, and iOS.
findings.impact: Pathological inputs may exhaust guest memory or reach the host timeout before a graceful refusal. The reported memory cap limits exposure, but the claimed timing margin is not established.
findings.title: Work-budget timing guarantees remain unverified

manualApproval.note: Approved on Martin's instruction 2026-10-20 (BN3), labelled experimental. Both medium findings are structural: the reviewer does not receive crates.io dependency sources (regex, unicode-width, num-bigint, num-traits; pinned in Cargo.lock), and guest timing on Android/iOS is unmeasured; the host's 250 ms plugin timeout still bounds runtime. Every code finding from two independent reviews and three registry audits is fixed; deterministic checks passed.
